items.title: Charles "Creole Charlie" Levy Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: And Joe Sutler was featured. They played Tiger Rag and played umpteen choruses, and everybody had a ball.

ctx.x: They were at Harmon's Dremlin. Yeah, and they also played on the Navy Pier. Yes. They played the Navy Pier. You hear them? Yes. Went to the Pier every night because Darnell played such a terrific violin, and he played so strong, you could hear the violin with the band. Other violin players, you couldn't hear them when the band was playing. And then he played all those extra notes that we were enthused over hearing, and I just made it my business to him. And Darnell was young. I think he's a year younger than I…
We came over. Before you joined Wycliffe, did you meet any fellas? Or get to know the jazz men around? Were you in any of the joints?
